He smoothed the creases against the warm chimney of the lantern, read it twice, and set it beside his clock, letting the dark sea take the glass shell back out.", "w02": "四点整，街面尚未苏醒，唯有环卫工的竹扫帚沙沙划过沥青。路灯泛着微黄的晕，被清晨的薄雾浸得发潮。头班电车亮着顶灯驶出车场，车厢空荡，碾过辙叉的声音分外清脆。临街豆腐坊的卷帘门哗啦拉开半截，蒸气裹着豆香漫上道口。夜色退去，曙色未明，整座城伏在破晓前最深的一口喘息里。", "w03": "- Imagine two mirrors facing each other, where you see yourself holding a mirror with another smaller you inside it, repeating endlessly.\n- In computing, it means solving a large chore by having a rule hand off a slightly smaller version of the same chore to itself.\n- It only works if there is a clear stopping point, like finally reaching the tiniest wooden doll inside a nesting set."}
